prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is visible, approach it. If unreachable, search. Then pick up. If heavy, call support. list of available nodes: <Action ID = PickUpObject    /> <Action ID = CallSupport    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectHeavy    /> <Sequence>     <Action ID = GrabObject    />     <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    />     <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> </Sequence> <Action ID = SearchForObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO PickUpObject
	ELSE
		SEQUENCE
				IF IsObjectHeavy? THEN
				DO CallSupport
		END
	END
